title: Auth verify OTP
summary: 6-digit (configurable) one-time-code verification page. Composes the auth-verify-otp block which auto-submits when the code is full and routes verification through adapter.verifyOtp({ code, intent }).
brief: Build an OTP entry page for sign-in via email/SMS code, post-signup email verification, or TOTP MFA challenge. Drive the heading + adapter routing from the `intent` prop.

steps.reason: The page-level block — manages the InputOTP value, auto-submit when full, error reset on failure, and resend cooldown.

checklist.check: Pass an AuthAdapter via the `adapter` prop with `verifyOtp` implemented. The block surfaces an 'unimplemented' error after the user types the full code.
`intent` is forwarded verbatim to both verifyOtp and resendOtp. Make sure your adapter routes each intent value to the correct backend endpoint.
`length` (default 6) must match the digit count your email / SMS template generates. Mismatched lengths leave the form unsubmittable.
Don't render a manual Submit button — the block auto-submits when the code reaches `length`. A second button confuses users and creates a double-call risk.
Keep `resendCooldownSeconds` ≥ 10 — lower invites accidental double-sends.
[AuthVerifyOtp] Avoid: Submitting the form yourself — the block already auto-submits when the code reaches `length`. Don't render an extra submit button.
[AuthVerifyOtp] Avoid: Hard-coding length=6 when the backend expects a different number — drive `length` from the same constant the email/SMS template uses.

[AuthVerifyOtp] Avoid: Mismatching intent between verifyOtp and resendOtp — the block forwards the same intent to both. If the consumer's adapter routes them differently, that's a bug to fix in the adapter, not the block.
[AuthVerifyOtp] Avoid: Showing the resend button when adapter.resendOtp isn't implemented — the block already hides it; don't re-implement that gate.
[AuthVerifyOtp] Avoid: Setting resendCooldownSeconds too low (< 10s) — invites accidental double-sends and tripping rate-limit responses.

[AuthVerifyOtp] A11y: InputOTP is labeled via aria-label='One-time code' so screen readers know what's being entered. Resend button uses the canonical loading prop (sets aria-busy + disabled). Cooldown countdown is reflected in the visible button label. Errors render in an Alert with role='alert'. The OTP value clears on error so users can re-enter without manually deleting digits.
[Input OTP] Avoid: Forgetting to render maxLength slots — the underlying input's maxLength won't match the visible UI
[Input OTP] Avoid: Using pattern without importing one of the REGEXP_ONLY_* constants from 'input-otp'
[Input OTP] Avoid: Wrapping the whole thing in a <form> without a submit handler — onComplete is often a better auto-submit hook
[Input OTP] Avoid: Overriding slot className in a way that removes the first/last border-radius rules

[Input OTP] A11y: input-otp manages a single hidden <input> so screen readers hear one field of N characters. Each slot is a visual representation. The active slot gets a focus ring via the ring token.
[Button] Avoid: Nesting interactive elements inside asChild button
[Button] Avoid: Using — breaks middle-click, cmd-click, and right-click → 'open in new tab', and skips the browser history entry
[Button] Avoid: Using <Button variant='destructive'> for recoverable actions like 'Reset filters' — reserve destructive for delete/archive/leave; use 'secondary' or 'ghost' for resets
[Button] Avoid: Using <Button size='icon'> without an aria-label — screen readers have nothing to announce; always pair icon-only buttons with aria-label or visible text
[Button] A11y: Automatically handles focus ring, disabled state, and aria attributes. Icon-only buttons MUST have aria-label. Loading state automatically sets disabled.
[Alert] Avoid: Using destructive for non-error messages
[Alert] Avoid: Missing AlertTitle (reduces scannability)
[Alert] Avoid: Stacking multiple Alerts on the same page instead of grouping
[Alert] A11y: Root renders role='alert' so screen readers announce it. For non-urgent info banners consider role='status' or aria-live='polite' via className overrides.
